name: Emily Watson
comment: Absolutely stunning view at Choryang Ibagu-gil! The atmosphere was peaceful and the locals were super friendly. Highly recommended!

name: David Miller
comment: One of my favorite places in Busan. Great spot for taking photos and experiencing authentic Korean coastal vibes.

name: Sophia Chen
comment: Very clean and eco-friendly environment. Easy to access with public transport. Will definitely come back again!

name: Markus Weber
comment: The audio guide was so helpful! Learned so much about the rich history of Choryang Ibagu-gil. 10/10 experience.

name: Jessica Taylor
comment: Breathtaking scenery and amazing local food nearby. A must-visit attraction for anyone visiting Busan!

name: John Doe
comment: Yongdusan Park & Busan Tower offers the absolute best panoramic night view of the entire city!

name: Sarah Jenkins
comment: Beautiful park located right in the heart of Jung-gu. Love the traditional bell pavilion.

name: Liam O'Connor
comment: Great tower view! Super convenient to get to from Nampo-dong station.

name: Hannah Kim
comment: The sunset view from Busan Tower observation deck is unforgettable.

name: Alex Rivera
comment: Wonderful historical park with clean walking paths and rich culture.
